name: firefly-iii_list_account
description: This endpoint returns a list of all the accounts owned by the authenticated user.

limit.description: Number of items per page. The default pagination is per 50 items.

page.description: Page number. The default pagination is per 50 items.

date.description: A date formatted YYYY-MM-DD. When added to the request, Firefly III will show the account's balance on that day.

type.description: The type of accounts you wish to limit the search to.

name: firefly-iii_store_account
description: Creates a new account. The data required can be submitted as a JSON body or as a list of parameters (in key=value pairs, like a webform).

type.description: Can only be one one these account types. import, initial-balance and reconciliation cannot be set manually.

opening_balance.description: Represents the opening balance, the initial amount this account holds.

opening_balance_date.description: Represents the date of the opening balance.

currency_id.description: Use either currency_id or currency_code. Defaults to the user's default currency.

currency_code.description: Use either currency_id or currency_code. Defaults to the user's default currency.

account_role.description: Is only mandatory when the type is asset.

credit_card_type.description: Mandatory when the account_role is ccAsset. Can only be monthlyFull or null.

monthly_payment_date.description: Mandatory when the account_role is ccAsset. Moment at which CC payment installments are asked for by the bank.

liability_type.description: Mandatory when type is liability. Specifies the exact type.

liability_direction.description: 'credit' indicates somebody owes you the liability. 'debit' Indicates you owe this debt yourself. Works only for liabiltiies.

interest.description: Mandatory when type is liability. Interest percentage.

interest_period.description: Mandatory when type is liability. Period over which the interest is calculated.

latitude.description: Latitude of the accounts's location, if applicable. Can be used to draw a map.

longitude.description: Latitude of the accounts's location, if applicable. Can be used to draw a map.

zoom_level.description: Zoom level for the map, if drawn. This to set the box right. Unfortunately this is a proprietary value because each map provider has different zoom levels.

requestBody.description: JSON array with the necessary account information or key=value pairs. See the model for the exact specifications.

name: firefly-iii_get_account
description: Returns a single account by its ID.

date.description: A date formatted YYYY-MM-DD. When added to the request, Firefly III will show the account's balance on that day.

name: firefly-iii_update_account
description: Used to update a single account. All fields that are not submitted will be cleared (set to NULL). The model will tell you which fields are mandatory.

currency_id.description: Use either currency_id or currency_code. Defaults to the user's default currency.

currency_code.description: Use either currency_id or currency_code. Defaults to the user's default currency.

account_role.description: Is only mandatory when the type is asset.

credit_card_type.description: Mandatory when the account_role is ccAsset. Can only be monthlyFull or null.

monthly_payment_date.description: Mandatory when the account_role is ccAsset. Moment at which CC payment installments are asked for by the bank.

liability_type.description: Mandatory when type is liability. Specifies the exact type.

interest.description: Mandatory when type is liability. Interest percentage.

interest_period.description: Mandatory when type is liability. Period over which the interest is calculated.

latitude.description: Latitude of the account's location, if applicable. Can be used to draw a map. If omitted, the existing location will be kept. If submitted as NULL, the current location will be removed.

longitude.description: Latitude of the account's location, if applicable. Can be used to draw a map. If omitted, the existing location will be kept. If submitted as NULL, the current location will be removed.

zoom_level.description: Zoom level for the map, if drawn. This to set the box right. Unfortunately this is a proprietary value because each map provider has different zoom levels. If omitted, the existing location will be kept. If submitted as NULL, the current location will be removed.

requestBody.description: JSON array or formdata with updated account information. See the model for the exact specifications.

name: firefly-iii_delete_account
description: Will permanently delete an account. Any associated transactions and piggy banks are ALSO deleted. Cannot be recovered from.

name: firefly-iii_list_transaction
description: List all the user's transactions.

limit.description: Number of items per page. The default pagination is per 50 items.

page.description: Page number. The default pagination is per 50 items.

start.description: A date formatted YYYY-MM-DD. This is the start date of the selected range (inclusive).

end.description: A date formatted YYYY-MM-DD. This is the end date of the selected range (inclusive).

type.description: Optional filter on the transaction type(s) returned.

name: firefly-iii_store_transaction
description: Creates a new transaction. The data required can be submitted as a JSON body or as a list of parameters.

error_if_duplicate_hash.description: Break if the submitted transaction exists already.

apply_rules.description: Whether or not to apply rules when submitting transaction.

fire_webhooks.description: Whether or not to fire the webhooks that are related to this event.

group_title.description: Title of the transaction if it has been split in more than one piece. Empty otherwise.

order.description: Order of this entry in the list of transactions.

currency_id.description: Currency ID. Default is the source account's currency, or the user's default currency. The value you submit may be overruled by the source or destination account.

currency_code.description: Currency code. Default is the source account's currency, or the user's default currency. The value you submit may be overruled by the source or destination account.

foreign_amount.description: The amount in a foreign currency.

foreign_currency_id.description: Currency ID of the foreign currency. Default is null. Is required when you submit a foreign amount.

foreign_currency_code.description: Currency code of the foreign currency. Default is NULL. Can be used instead of the foreign_currency_id, but this or the ID is required when submitting a foreign amount.

budget_id.description: The budget ID for this transaction.

budget_name.description: The name of the budget to be used. If the budget name is unknown, the ID will be used or the value will be ignored.

category_id.description: The category ID for this transaction.

category_name.description: The name of the category to be used. If the category is unknown, it will be created. If the ID and the name point to different categories, the ID overrules the name.

source_id.description: ID of the source account. For a withdrawal or a transfer, this must always be an asset account. For deposits, this must be a revenue account.

source_name.description: Name of the source account. For a withdrawal or a transfer, this must always be an asset account. For deposits, this must be a revenue account. Can be used instead of the source_id. If the transaction is a deposit, the source_name can be filled in freely: the account will be created based on the name.

destination_id.description: ID of the destination account. For a deposit or a transfer, this must always be an asset account. For withdrawals this must be an expense account.

destination_name.description: Name of the destination account. You can submit the name instead of the ID. For everything except transfers, the account will be auto-generated if unknown, so submitting a name is enough.

reconciled.description: If the transaction has been reconciled already. When you set this, the amount can no longer be edited by the user.

piggy_bank_id.description: Optional. Use either this or the piggy_bank_name

piggy_bank_name.description: Optional. Use either this or the piggy_bank_id

bill_id.description: Optional. Use either this or the bill_name

bill_name.description: Optional. Use either this or the bill_id

internal_reference.description: Reference to internal reference of other systems.

external_id.description: Reference to external ID in other systems.

external_url.description: External, custom URL for this transaction.

bunq_payment_id.description: Internal ID of bunq transaction. Field is no longer used but still works.

requestBody.description: JSON array or key=value pairs with the necessary transaction information. See the model for the exact specifications.
